Every time she complained about the symptoms the doctors at this practice dismissed it and sent her away. By the time her cancer was finally properly investigated, it had spread to her liver, lungs, and lymph nodes. She died two months later.
I believe if these doctors had listened to her and investigated properly when she kept telling them something was wrong, she would still be alive today.
